info.title: OMA LwM2M Periodic Sensor Sampler (Object ID 10494)

Periodic_Sensor_Sampler.label: Periodic Sensor Sampler
Periodic_Sensor_Sampler.description: The autosen Periodic Sensor Sampler object can be used to sample one or more sensor value(s) at periodic intervals

Sensor_Value_Path.label: Sensor Value Path
Sensor_Value_Path.description:
Resources are specified using Core Link syntax
Example:
Instance #0: </3303/0/5700>
Instance #1: </3303/1/5700>

Sampling_Start_Time.label: Sampling Start Time
Sampling_Start_Time.description: Specifies the number of seconds after midnight UTC from which the sampler should be started

Sampling_Interval.label: Sampling Interval
Sampling_Interval.description: Specifies the Interval at which the sampling is to be repeated from the Sampling Start Time.

Sampling_Count.label: Sampling Count
Sampling_Count.description: Specifies the number of intervals to be performed in the sampling interval, starting from the Sampling Start Time

Step_Filter.label: Step Filter
Step_Filter.description: Only when the value pointed by LwM2M resource Sensor Value Path changes by more than Step Filter the Sampler should evaluate the value

Sampling_Days_of_the_Week.label: Sampling Days of the Week
Sampling_Days_of_the_Week.description: Specifies the days of the week when sampling should occur. The value is a single byte (bitmask), where Bit 0 = Sunday, Bit 1 = Monday, ..., Bit 6 = Saturday

Sampling_Recurrence.label: Sampling Recurrence
Sampling_Recurrence.description:
Specifies the Recurrence in days in which the Sampler will be executed. This works in combination with "Sampling Days of the Week" (ID 5),  
        allowing finer control over when sampling occurs.
